name: Santa Barbara Zoo Jobs for Teens (Guest Experience Specialist and seasonal)
what_you_do: Entry-level seasonal jobs such as Guest Experience Specialist and Zoo Camp positions. The Zoo says most openings are for applicants 14 and older and it welcomes first-time workers for entry-level roles.
who_can_apply: Most of our job opportunities are open to applicants 14 years and older; some positions require that an applicant be at least 16 or 18. You must be able to present proof of citizenship or legal right to work in the United States. Most positions require some related experience and/or an educational background in a related field. Students with no prior work experience: 'We will consider your application for our entry level positions.'
pay_detail: Not stated on the page; see each job listing.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The Zoo says the busiest hiring is a month before spring and summer school breaks.
how_to_apply: Apply online for a specific opening on the Zoo's Employment Listings page. One application per job.
notes: The Employment Listings page was not read, so check whether any openings are posted now. Under-18 workers need a work permit from their school district.
